Jordan: Heads up \u2014 Ana Rivera booked to start Mon 05/06. Flight lands Sun 21:40. Checkr status: 'Pending \u2014 ID verification'. I-9 slot currently Mon 10:30 but security desk closes 18:30 so late badge pickup won't work. Ideas? :wave:
Tara: Can we swap the I-9 to Mon 08:00? Raj, can you cover early verification?
Raj: Yes I can do 08:00. If Checkr clears before then we can badge same day.
Emily: If candidate prefers Sunday evening, we can authorize a vetted courier to collect documents at arrivals (requires written consent). Courier costs billed to hiring req.
Sam-Ops: I can coordinate courier but need candidate consent and copy of passport via secure upload.
Security-Team: Reception can issue a temporary visitor pass for 08:00 arrival. Final badge requires BG clearance.
IT-Logistics: Laptop ETA Mon 07:45. We'll leave sealed at reception labelled 'ANA RIVERA - HOLD'.
People-ops-bot: Ana Rivera completed DocuSign I-9 consent. Checkr link: https://checkr.example/ana (id 79022).
Candidate-Ana: (candidate) I can meet courier at Terminal 2 baggage claim at 22:00 Sun. I consent to courier pick-up. Thanks!
Jordan: Plan A: courier pickup Sun 22:00 -> deliver to reception Mon 07:30 -> 08:00 I-9 (Raj) -> laptop handoff -> orientation 09:00. Plan B: remote-first day if Checkr flags.
Tara: Added contingency escalation template: https://redwoodhr.docs/onboard/escalation-template. Ping me if anything comes up. :white_check_mark:
